in_sanskrit.name: शत्रुधनुष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who gives or bears an enemy. The name of a popular actor in Indian cinema, Shatrughan Sinha.

in_hindi.name: शत्रुग्हन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who bears an enemy. (In Hindi, शत्रु means enemy, and धनुष means a bow. So, Shatrughan can be interpreted as one who wields a bow against an enemy.)

in_tamil.name: சத்துரோஜன
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is the enemy of himself or one's own self. (In Tamil, சத்துர் means enemy, and ஜனம் means self or being. So, Shatrughan can be interpreted as one who is an enemy to oneself or one's own being.)

in_telugu.name: శత్రుఘన
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has a large number of enemies. (In Telugu, శత్రు means enemy, and ఘన means a large number. So, Shatrughan can be interpreted as one who has a large number of enemies.)

in_marathi.name: Shatrughan

in_bengali.name: Shatrughan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Having Enemies

data.cultural_impact: The name Shatrughan is derived from the Sanskrit words "Shatru" which means enemies or adversaries, and "ghan" which means protecting or fortress. Historically, in Hindu mythology, there have been numerous warriors, gods, and heroes with the name Shatrughan, highlighting the importance of strength and bravery in protecting against enemies. One famous mythological incarnation of Shatrughan was King Shalva, who was blessed with the boon that he would be invincible to all except one enemy. Thus, he was known as Shatrughan or the "Lord of a Hundred Enemies." The name continues to be popular in modern India, reflecting the resilient spirit of the Indian people who have faced numerous challenges and adversities throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Shatrughan can be interpreted in several ways. One interpretation is that the name represents the internal struggle between good and evil within each individual. Just as Shatrughan represents the strength to protect from external enemies, it can also symbolize the strength required to overcome internal adversaries- namely, negative thoughts, emotions, and habits. In this sense, the name can serve as a reminder to constantly strive towards self-improvement and spiritual growth, and to never give in to the temptations of the ego or attachment to material possessions. Another interpretation is that the name represents the idea of transcending duality, as the name itself suggests being "beyond" or "protected from" all enemies, which can be seen as an allegory for the ultimate goal of spiritual liberation, or Moksha, beyond the dualities of this material world. Ultimately, the name Shatrughan carries with it a powerful message of strength, resilience, and the inherent capacity to overcome all challenges, both internal and external.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Shatrughan was a king in ancient India, mentioned in the Mahabharata. The name Shatrughan carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Shatrughan remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Maya Shatrughan in Chennai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Shatrughan, which means "Having Enemies". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Shatrughan, meaning 'having hundreds of enemies', symbolizes the inner strength and courage to face adversity and overcome challenges despite numerous opposition. It embodies the spirit of resilience and the unwavering determination to protect and uphold one's values.

seo.description_paragraph: The name Shatrughan is derived from the Sanskrit language and holds significant importance in Hinduism. It is believed to be a powerful name, associated with courage, strength, and victory over enemies. According to Hindu mythology, Shatrughan is the name of the youngest brother of Lord Rama and is revered for his unwavering loyalty and bravery. The name has been popular among Hindus for generations and continues to be a favorite choice for parents today. Pronounced as sha-tru-gahn, it is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy.
